basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old football enthusiast from Manchester, UK. I work as a software developer by day and spend my evenings immersed in the world of FIFA Ultimate Team. My interests revolve around football analytics, gaming, and improving my programming skills. I have a knack for strategy games and enjoy discussing tactics on various forums. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after work, often sipping a cup of tea while reviewing the latest player stats.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have self-taught myself football analytics over the years through online courses and extensive reading. My love for football started in childhood, and I've combined it with my technical skills to analyze player performances and game strategies.
